log: ENERGY PER BOND AND PER ATOM
The compartment totals said a methyl puts 0.04% of its strain at the DNA-histone interface,
which reads as 'marks do not touch the grip'. But that is a total over 264,000 springs, and
a total cannot tell energy spread thinly over every bond from energy concentrated in a few.
Those have identical bucket sums and completely different meanings. A 0.04% share is also
entirely compatible with the single most-strained bond being an interface contact.
